features:
Key Features;

Made with whole grain corn as the primary ingredient

Certified gluten-free — suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity

No artificial flavors, colors, or high fructose corn syrup

Fortified with essential vitamins and minerals like iron, B-vitamins (B1, B2, B6, folic acid, B12), vitamin D, and zinc

Contains approximately 110–150 calories per serving (about 1 cup)

Low in fat and moderate in carbohydrates with 3–4g of sugar per serving

Key Benefits:

Safe for gluten-free diets and allergy-conscious households

Fortified with nutrients that support energy, immunity, and metabolism

Versatile and mild in flavor, great for breakfast or as a crunchy snack base

A lighter cereal option with no cholesterol, making it heart-friendly

Easily paired with fruits, nuts, or yogurt to make a balanced and satisfying meal

Popular among both kids and adults for its crisp texture and clean taste
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Corn Meal, Sugar, Corn Starch, Salt, Baking Soda. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
